items: 2026 IRS estimated-tax 90% current / 100% prior / 110% higher-income rule and $150k/$75k threshold verified.
CRA Quick Method 1% credit on first CAD 30,000 and current method structure verified; remittance rate remains user-selected from CRA table.
Headline VAT/GST thresholds retained as dated reference set; UK 90k, Canada 30k, NZ 60k, Singapore 1m verified; AU/India remain explicitly caveated reference values.
Form 8606 pro-rata aggregation/formula relationship remains consistent with IRS guidance; no annual statutory threshold embedded.
No city tax database embedded; user must enter verified local rates.
No IFTA tax-rate table embedded; quarterly jurisdiction rates are user-entered from official matrix.
No state paid-leave table embedded; replacement rate/cap/weeks are user-entered and explicitly unverified by tool.
Federal >40-hour overtime/FWW abstraction remains caveated; state law/minimum wage is user-entered, not hard-coded as a state rule.
Spain 2026 EUR 2,442 + 916 + 306 and Estonia EUR 3,960/month verified; Portugal threshold intentionally requires verified user input.
IRS 2026 §415(c) annual-additions limit USD 72,000 and USD 24,500 elective deferral reference verified.
Post-2019 inherited-IRA 10-year scope is limited to non-eligible designated beneficiaries; after-RBD annual-RMD caveat retained.
No statutory withholding rate embedded; all federal/state/FICA and estimated true rates are user inputs.
2026 Part B standard premium USD 202.90, 10% per full 12-month Part B penalty model, and Part D USD 38.99 base/1% per month verified.
2026 CMS IRMAA thresholds, Part B premiums and Part D IRMAA amounts match current CMS table.
Stepped-up/date-of-death FMV basis is presented as an abstraction with special-rule caveats; no changing threshold embedded.
2026/27 England/Wales/NI personal allowance GBP 12,570 and 20/40/45% bands through GBP 37,700/125,140 verified.
Section 24 20% basic-rate reducer model remains caveated; corporation/dividend rates are user inputs rather than hard-coded current rates.
2026/27 pension annual allowance GBP 60,000 and carry-forward years 2023/24–2025/26 verified; tapered/MPAA cases explicitly excluded or user-supplied.
UK seven-year gift rule and taper tax rates 40/32/24/16/8% verified.
2026/27 ShPP GBP 194.32/week or 90% earnings, 50 leave weeks and 37 pay weeks verified.
No state entitlement rate embedded; user must enter applicable legally verified accrual rate.
California daily >8h 1.5x, >12h 2x and meal-period structure retained with explicit exclusions; claim validity is not inferred.
